youtube.title: Why Soap Can Remove Grease Water Can't 🧼 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Soap molecules have a hydrophilic head that bonds with water and a hydrophobic tail that bonds with grease. In water they surround oil droplets and form tiny balls called micelles, which the rinse water carries away. That is how soap removes grease that water alone cannot.
